title: 26. Classify retries and cap backoff

examples.explanation: 503 two times, then 200. The delays are 2, then 4 capped to 3.
400 is not retryable, so the client stops after 1 attempt.
Two retryable failures with a maximum of 2 attempts: `exhausted`, with one delay.

hints: Return immediately for success and permanent failure.
The first delay is base, subject to the cap.
